fewShots.question: Which service categories have the longest average wait time?
fewShots.query: EVALUATE TOPN(10, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(CommunityHealthAccess[ServiceCategory], "Average Wait Days", [Average Wait Days]), [Average Wait Days], DESC)

fewShots.question: What is the no-show rate by facility neighborhood?
How many referrals were completed by service category?
What are the total reported appointments, average wait days, and no-show rate in this synthetic dataset?
fewShots.query: EVALUATE ROW("Reported Appointments", [Appointments], "Average Wait Days", [Average Wait Days], "No-Show Rate", [No-Show Rate])

fewShots.question: Which facility capacity snapshots exceeded 85 percent utilization in September 2026?
fewShots.query: EVALUATE TOPN(10, FILTER(FacilityCapacity, FacilityCapacity[SnapshotDate] >= DATE(2026, 9, 1) && FacilityCapacity[SnapshotDate] < DATE(2026, 10, 1) && FacilityCapacity[UtilizationRate] > 0.85), FacilityCapacity[UtilizationRate], DESC, FacilityCapacity[CapacitySnapshotId], ASC)
